description: Performance controller: knobs, buttons and faders are added from its menus, given labels, and mapped to as many as four parameters each anywhere in the patch

params.text: A knob, button or fader added from the module menu, sending its position to every parameter it is mapped to; right-clicking it opens its type, label, colour and mappings

notes: the knob and the button the module comes up with control nothing until they are mapped: right-click a tile, open Map 1, choose Start mapping, then click the knob it should control.
right-clicking a tile opens that tile's own menu, with its name, its Controller type or Separator type, its colour, its four map slots, and Move to, Copy, Paste, Hide, Duplicate and Delete.
Range, under Map 1 to Map 4 in a tile's own menu, sets the span of the mapped parameter, with Range presets of Default, Invert, 0-50%, 25-75% and 50-100%.
two PatchMaster modules placed next to each other draw as one continuous panel.
the module ships presets named after what they control, such as VCO, VCF, ADSR Knobs and Mixer, each laying out a set of named and labelled tiles with their mappings left empty.
menu: Add new controller — adds a tile to the panel: a knob in Small, Medium or Large, a button in one of six kinds, or a fader in Large, X-Large or XX-Large
Add new separator — adds a Divider label for naming a section of the panel, or a Blank tile in one of six sizes
Show mapping lights on PatchMaster — lights a small indicator on each controller that has a mapping
Hide mapping indicators — takes away the coloured outline drawn around each mapped knob on the module it belongs to
Show knob arcs — draws the position arc around each knob
Show blank tiles — draws the blank separator tiles rather than leaving their space empty
Allow ctrl/cmd + click drag to move tiles — lets a tile be dragged up or down the panel with ctrl or cmd held
Precision — how often mapped parameters are written: Sample Rate, SR ÷ 4 (default), SR ÷ 128, and On changes only
Visibility (if space) — a check beside each tile's name, showing or hiding that tile where the panel has room for it
Unmap all controllers — clears every mapping on the module
